title: NovaFabric: A Black-Box Recorder for AI Agents with Sealed, Replayable, Diffable and Auditable Runs
abstract: arXiv:2610.34594v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An AI agent run is no longer a function call. It is a cascade of prompts, model calls, tool invocations, file and network effects and sub-agents. When such a run misbehaves, or an auditor asks what happened, logs and traces answer poorly: they are mutable, partial and cannot be re-executed. This technical report describes NovaFabric, an open-source (Apache-2.0) black-box recorder for AI agents that turns a run into a sealed, replayable, diffable and auditable evidence capsule. The design rests on two formats only. The Run Capsule is a directory of flat files and the source of truth; every database is a rebuildable index over capsules. The Evidence Bundle is the signed export for an auditor. Everything else follows existing standards: OpenTelemetry GenAI, OpenLineage, W3C PROV, in-toto/DSSE, RFC 3161 and CycloneDX. A single-node run is the smallest case of a distributed one; the schema supports a capsule hierarchy for Slurm arrays and K

translated_title: NovaFabric：一种面向AI智能体的黑盒记录器，实现密封、可重放、可对比且可审计的运行记录
translated_abstract: AI智能体的一次运行不再是一个简单的函数调用，而是由提示词、模型调用、工具调用、文件与网络副作用以及子智能体组成的级联过程。当这样的运行出现异常行为，或审计人员询问究竟发生了什么时，日志和追踪信息往往难以给出令人满意的答案：它们是可变的、不完整的，且无法重新执行。本技术报告介绍了NovaFabric，一个开源（Apache-2.0协议）的AI智能体黑盒记录器，它能将一次运行转化为密封、可重放、可对比、可审计的证据胶囊。该设计仅基于两种格式：运行胶囊是一个扁平文件目录，作为唯一可信数据源；每个数据库都是基于胶囊可重建的索引。证据包则是提供给审计人员的签名导出文件。其余一切都遵循现有标准：OpenTelemetry GenAI、OpenLineage、W3C PROV、in-toto/DSSE、RFC 3161和CycloneDX。单节点运行是分布式运行的最小情形；该模式支持面向Slurm数组和Kubernetes的胶囊层级结构。
tldr: 提出了开源黑盒记录器NovaFabric，可将AI智能体的复杂运行过程封装为密封、可重放、可对比且可审计的证据胶囊，解决了传统日志可变、不完整且无法重放执行的问题。
en_tdlr: NovaFabric is an open-source black-box recorder that transforms AI agent runs into sealed, replayable, diffable, and auditable evidence capsules, overcoming the limitations of mutable, partial, and non-replayable logs and traces.
